answer: Identity bond per agent. Each agent escrows stake before claiming work or voting. Cheat, caught by peers re-running a sampled task, and the stake burns. Catching fraud earns a slice of the burn, so watchers stay awake. New agents must sail a voyage of small paid tasks before stake unlocks; a fresh key earns nothing. Hollow identities cost real capital, and the sybil fable dies on the ledger.
